name: Vera Drew
bio:
Vera Drew (born May 22, 1989) is an American filmmaker, actress, and comedian. She is best known for her film The People's Joker, which she directed, wrote, produced and starred in.

credits.title: Tell Me I’m Worthless
credits.overview: Adaptation of Alison Rumfitt's dark, unflinching haunted house novel that takes readers from the well of the literary gothic, up through Brighton’s queer scene, and out into the heart of modern day trans experience in the UK.

credits.title: Castration Movie Part 4: Endless September
credits.overview: This conclusion to Chapter iii. is followed by two side quests. In the first, stand-up comic Reagan Lee Omaha gets her big break. In the second, Persephone makes amends.

credits.title: Saddled
credits.overview: A feature length film about a troubled alcoholic who's already precarious existence is thrown into complete chaos after he is abducted by aliens. It's either a tragic comedy about alien abduction or comedic tragedy about addiction.

credits.overview: Michaela tries her best to be a good person.

credits.title: The Angels
credits.overview: A desperate film student stranded in Los Angeles without a summer internship lands an interview with the mysterious producer Vip Armé. All the while, she's haunted by visions of the legendary silent-era director Lois Weber, America's first great female filmmaker.

credits.title: Castration Movie World Tour Anthology ii. The Best of Both a Question and a Comment
credits.overview: A tour diary for Castration Movie part two. This hourlong collection of tour footage and live Q&As features stops in New York, Dallas, Austin, Dublin, Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh, Los Angeles, Sydney and Auckland. Edited by Elizabeth Purchell.

credits.title: The Serpent's Skin
credits.overview: Two young women form a romantic bond after discovering they have supernatural powers. Their insecurities unknowingly release a demon, which possesses one of their exes and begins feeding on their friends. As the bodies pile up, it becomes up to the women to face their pasts and stop the growing evil.

credits.title: Castration Movie Expansion Pack i. You're Weird, But I Love You!
credits.overview: A feature-length deleted scenes movie from the Blu-ray release of the anthology series Castration Movie.

credits.title: Castration Movie Documentary Anthology i. You Had To Be There
credits.overview: Over the course of nearly two years, Louise Weard and her loved ones test the limits of filmmaking, friendship and sanity as they try to finish shooting her seven-hour epic: The Untitled Louise Weard Castration Movie.

credits.title: Every Heavy Thing
credits.overview: A journey centered around an ad-seller for one of the last alt-weeklies in the country, who, after witnessing a murder, is intimidated into being the killer's reluctant accomplice.

credits.title: Castration Movie Anthology I. Traps
credits.overview: Michaela 'Traps' Sinclair is a trans sex worker trying to get by in Vancouver while also mentoring her recently-out friend Adeline and making an attempt at pursuing actual motherhood. Meanwhile, lowly production assistant Turner finds himself dangerously spiraling into inceldom as his current relationship implodes.
